material: Steel enclosure, vacuum circuit breakers, C5 coating
remarks: Busbar 2000 A same as section A for interchangeability; incomer 1250 A (20BBT 16 MVA = 880 A). MV switchgear 12 kV class, 31.5 kA / 1 s (peak 80 kA): bus-tie closed short-circuit = 10BBT 14.4 kA + 20BBT 8.8 kA + MV motor contribution about 2 kA = 25 kA, 25 % margin; 40 kA not required. Panels: incomer, tie, BFP B, CEP B, CW pump B, SWRO HP pump B, fire pump, LV transformers 00BFT20/40, spare.
service: 10.5 kV MV switchboard section B (fed from ST UAT 20BBT)
